data.name: Mahrabahaat
data.gender_notes: Mahrabahaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah and to his Beloved Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Mahrabahaat carries the meaning “Lover, Devoted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahrabahaat usually hope their child will grow to embody lover, devoted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A devoted and loving servant of Allah
data.etymology: Mahrabahaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover, Devoted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahrabahaat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: محرَباهات
in_arabic.meaning: مكان إقامة الرِجال في القَناة أو المَآرب
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحرَباهات: مَنزِلُ الرِجالِ في المَآربِ، يَسمي مَنزِلَ الرِجالِ إِذا كانَ مُفصَلًا عَن مَنزِلَ النِساءِ، وَهو مِن مُشتقاتِ الْمَحرَبِ، وَالْمَحرَبُ: مَنزِلُ الرِجالِ، وَهو مِن مَولودِ الْحَرَبِ، وَالْحَرَبُ: الَّتي يُقتَنَعُ فيها بِالجَنادِبِ، وَفَعلَها قَوَدَ: قَدَعَ بِالجَنادِبِ، وَالجَنادِبُ: الحِمى وَمَنزِلُ الرِجالِ فيها، وَهو مُحَرَّكٌ مِن مُحَرَّكِ الْحَرَبِ، وَالْحَرَبُ: الَّتي يُقتَنَعُ فيها، وَالأَصلُ الَّذي يُستَنسخُ مِنْهُ: قَدَعَ بِالجَنادِبِ، وَالجَنادِبُ: الحِمى وَمَنزِلُ الرِجالِ فيها، وَالجَنادِبُ: المَنزِلُ مِنَ الزَوالِ، وَالزَوالُ: الَّذي يَستَغثُ عَن ذَلِكَ، وَالمُشتَقٌّ مِن هَذا الاسمِ: مَحْرَبَةٌ، وَهِيَ مَنزِلُ الرِجالِ في الأَرضِ

It is a name that represents commitment, dedication, and a strong bond with Allah and His Messenger.

It is a constant reminder of the importance of keeping the focus on Allah and striving to live a life in accordance with His teachings. The spiritual significance of this name inspires an individual to continually work on their spiritual growth and to seek Allah's pleasure through embodiment of His commands and the love of His Prophet (PBUH) in every aspect of their life.
